## Talent Tactics Newsletter

Introducing "Talent Tactics"! Dive into our bi-weekly newsletter featuring in-depth guides on using AI to enhance recruiting workflows. Join us to explore how AI can change talent acquisition for good.

[Read now](https://speak.careers/updates/talent-tactics-newsletter)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/62d6d36f5e0c51ac7e3267b9/660d69f6e00041a958cbcfec_04-24-speak-candidate.png)

## Enhanced Candidate Matching

In our latest update, we've upgraded our candidate scoring feature based on user feedback. The improvements include refined algorithms, customizable parameters, comprehensive candidate analysis, detailed score explanations, and the ability to flag candidates who don't meet specified criteria.

[Read now](https://speak.careers/updates/enhanced-candidate-matching)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/62d6d36f5e0c51ac7e3267b9/660d652a80b69757af6ca988_04-24-speak-ats-integration.png)

## Seamless ATS Integrations

We've been hard at work ensuring that our platform is accessible to everyone. We're excited to announce seamless integrations with several leading ATS platforms, including Greenhouse, Ashby, Workable, and Lever.

[Read now](https://speak.careers/updates/seamless-ats-integrations)
